faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Madras University Guest Lecturer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Madras University Guest Lecturer (Full Time) posts is 28th July 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Lecturer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. Degree in Geology or Applied Geology to be eligible for the Guest Lecturer (Full Time) position at Madras University.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Lecturer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Guest Lecturer (Full Time) position announced by Madras University in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Guest Lecturer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Guest Lecturer (Full Time) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for the Madras University Guest Lecturer (Full Time) recruitment must be submitted in offline mode. Candidates need to send their filled application form via post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Guest Lecturer role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a merit-based evaluation of educational qualifications, teaching experience, publications, and rank, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. Where is Madras University located?
faq.answer: Madras University is located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 600025.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 5887/2026-27/GL/Geo./UNOM/.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the Guest Lecturer position?
faq.answer: The Guest Lecturer (Full Time) position at Madras University is a contractual job.
